docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Udayanācārya’s Nyāya argument for the existence of God, with the commentary of Haridāsa Bhaṭṭācārya, in Sanskrit and in Cowell’s English translation (Calcutta, 1864). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Library of Congress; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Kusumánjali : or, Hindu proof of the existence of a supreme being · Udayanācārya · 1864, 182 scanned pages. Published 1864; Edward Byles Cowell died 1903; the text and its commentary are medieval; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
